request.description: Requires a mapped exact unit with no overlapping inventory rows in the requested half-open interval.

exec: const payload = pm.response.json(); const value = payload.data && payload.data.propertyAvailability;

pm.test('BOOKING TENTATIVE overlap blocks availability', () => { pm.expect(payload.errors).to.be.undefined; pm.expect(value.available).to.eql(false); pm.expect(value.overlaps.some((entry) => entry.type === 'BOOKING' && entry.status === 'TENTATIVE')).to.eql(true); });

item.name: CHANNEL active block is unavailable and sanitized

exec: const payload = pm.response.json(); const value = payload.data && payload.data.propertyAvailability;

pm.test('CHANNEL ACTIVE overlap blocks and exposes only provider', () => { const overlap = value.overlaps.find((entry) => entry.type === 'CHANNEL' && entry.status === 'ACTIVE'); pm.expect(payload.errors).to.be.undefined; pm.expect(value.available).to.eql(false); pm.expect(overlap).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(overlap.channelProvider).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: Released and cancelled history is nonblocking

exec: const payload = pm.response.json(); const value = payload.data && payload.data.propertyAvailability;

pm.test('RELEASED and CANCELLED history remains visible but nonblocking', () => { const statuses = value.overlaps.map((entry) => entry.status); pm.expect(payload.errors).to.be.undefined; pm.expect(value.available).to.eql(true); pm.expect(statuses).to.include('RELEASED'); pm.expect(statuses).to.include('CANCELLED'); });

pm.test('overlaps are deterministically ordered', () => { const keys = value.overlaps.map((entry) => [entry.startDate, entry.endDateExclusive, entry.type, entry.status, entry.channelProvider || ''].join('|')); pm.expect(keys).to.eql([...keys].sort()); });
